analysis: The substring call is executed only when hostAddress is non-null, non-empty, starts with '[', and has length > 2 with last character ']'. Under these conditions, hostAddress.length() >= 3. The substring parameters are beginIndex=1 and endIndex=length-1. Since endIndex = length-1 is less than length (and non-negative), and beginIndex=1 is non-negative and less than endIndex, no IndexOutOfBoundsException can occur.
remark: All conditions that could throw IndexOutOfBoundsException are prevented by the prior checks: hostAddress is guaranteed to have length at least 3, beginIndex is 1 (non-negative), and endIndex is length-1 (less than the string length and greater than beginIndex). Therefore, no exception from substring is possible.
